scope: Bounded geometry interface audit, not full theorem formalization.

input.claim: Finite oriented simple triangulated sphere; dual perfect matching; nonmatching marked edge; retained cyclic frames and epsilon; original component test.

topology.claim: Inverse cut gives the original S3 augmented diagram, primitive disk bases and n=epsilon-2p.

packing.claim: Strict Hall feasibility, interior entropy maximizer, injective center development and support halfspaces give positive ideal right-angled cut polyhedron.

complete_metric.claim: Original face pairings and cusp links give complete Y with Vol(Y)=2Vol(Q).

finite_source.claim: Exact homogeneous Morse coefficient, original degree d targets, protected zeros, full Hermite and raw scalars.

complete_action.claim: Original endpoint determinant calibration and facet coning give P(q*)=Phi=Vol(Y)/(2pi), gradient0.

circle_germ.claim: Marked line-circle Jacobian invertible; analytic common pattern and source stationary radii agree.

group_germ.claim: Full reflection prefixes, cup/cap identities, threading and signed Hurwitz maps give actual framed rho_delta near rho0.

peripheral.claim: Primitive logs U=-Log R0-epsilon Log(-J), V=2Log(-J); actual main groups remain parabolic.

regulator.claim: Fixed oriented fundamental-chain volume differential gives absolute corrected action identity.

critical_point.claim: Multivariate reciprocal-slope IFT gives first charge; U+pV=-2pi i and Im delta>0.

metric_completion.claim: Actual small log periods, nonunit auxiliary multiplier and primitive angle2pi fill smooth solid tori; main cusps remain complete.

filled_action.claim: Same boundary triangulation axis comparison identifies 2pi Re S with actual filled metric volume.

central_asymptotic.claim: O analytic part: H1/H2, first Gaussian and all charge currents give nonzero central period at both parities.

central_volume.claim: Central contribution rate equals actual original filled complement volume.

weak_balance.claim: Additional actual complete-radius inequalities, with fixed finite data.

remainder.claim: P power flattening and one shared torus give full-minus-central real-cube gap.

hermite_bound.claim: N finite operator norm transfers the remainder at subexponential cost for fixed powers.

full_volume.claim: Increase fixed long-twist threshold; central rate dominates, hence original normalized invariant volume limit.

exact_checks: primitive meridian eigenvalues and determinant, epsilon=-1
primitive meridian eigenvalues and determinant, epsilon=0
primitive meridian eigenvalues and determinant, epsilon=1
O(mcgeq24) exact real boundary cancellation for either sign of p
O(mcgeq18-20) exact differential after boundary correction

limitations: No reproof or rerun of analytic H1/H2 constants and Fourier tails.
No proof-assistant verification of Hall packing, fundamental-chain differential, or metric completion.
Full invariant conclusion requires weak balance/quantified remainder and fixed sufficiently long powers.
